description: The pie chart presents the distribution of items across topical categories for the paper “Automatic Evaluation of Attribution by Large Language Models,” showing 11 slices in total. The slices are labeled with callouts and percentages: AI/NLP Research (blue) at about 24.3%, Econ. & Fin. (teal) at about 18.4%, Game&Anime (orange) at about 8.2%, History (yellow) at about 8.2%, Daily Life (light cyan) at about 7.1%, Science (light blue) at about 6.7%, Business (red) at about 5.9%, Pet & Animal (light orange) at about 5.5%, Law (pink) at about 5.1%, Geography (yellow-gold) at about 2.7%, and Math (green) at about 1.2%. Percent values are shown next to the labels outside the pie rather than inside the slices, there is no separate legend, and no slice appears exploded or otherwise visually emphasized; the slice sizes appear to vary without an obvious strict ordering around the circle.
